name: Si4713 FM and RDS (Retiring)
author: Nick Anderson (ShadowLight8)
description: This plugin is retiring after FPP 10 - switch to the **Dynamic_RDS** plugin, which supports the Si4713 board. Support for Adafruit's Si4713 FM transmitter breakout board with RDS / Radio Text support.

privacy.summary: Broadcasts the song title, artist, track number and other text you set to FM radios nearby. Nothing is sent over the network.

sends.what: the song title, artist, track number and other text you set
sends.why: to show what's playing on listeners' radios

systemChanges.what: installs the python3-smbus package from Debian during install, or when you click to reinstall it on the settings page
asks FPP to restart after install

privacy.other: Settings pages on FPP's web server can reset the transmitter's GPIO pin and reinstall a package as root; they have the same protection as FPP's own pages.
